title: AR / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter


Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join a North American team supporting a hybrid environment with a strong focus on VMware and Azure Cloud. This role is primarily hands-on and involves managing, modernizing, and migrating a large-scale virtualized environment to the cloud, while also supporting core networking and security components. The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

Financial Reporting Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst tto support financial reporting, analysis, and data-driven decision-making, ensuring accuracy, visibility, and actionable insights across the business.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Reporting Analyst / Accountant to support financial reporting, accounting operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This role bridges financial reporting and accounting, ensuring accurate financial records, reliable reporting, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with analytical capabilities, contributing to both operational excellence and strategic visibility.

  • Experience with month-end close and reconciliations

  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems is a plus

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Revley Payments Engineer — Stripe Connect / White-Label Payments Platform
description:
Company Description

Revley is the commerce operating system for the next generation of subscription brands. Headquartered in Manhattan. Bootstrapped. Profitable.


We exist because the modern commerce stack is broken. Brands stitch together a checkout from one vendor, a subscription engine from another, a payment processor from a third, a chargeback tool from a fourth — and spend more time managing the seams than growing. We replace all of it. One platform. Payments, subscriptions, checkout, tokenization, analytics, and revenue protection — unified, owned by the merchant, portable across every processor.


Our largest merchant processes $20M/month. In 8 months we've signed enterprise contracts with 12 partners including Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Nuvei, NMI, Finix, Braintree, and Authorize.net. Brands using Revley don't rent their payment infrastructure. They own it.


We move fast, ship daily, and treat every merchant relationship like the one that defines the company. We value ownership, transparency, and craftsmanship over process. We build for ambitious teams the way we'd want to be built for. If you've ever looked at the commerce stack and thought this should be one thing, not ten — you already understand Revley.

This is a full-time remote role for a Payments Engineer specializing in Stripe Connect and white-label payments platforms at Revley. The role includes designing, building, and optimizing scalable payment infrastructure, integrating Stripe Connect, and enabling white-label payment solutions. This engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure and seamless payment processing, proactively identify and address technical challenges, and stay updated with emerging payment technologies.

title: VFX- Subject Matter Expert
description:
VFX- Fully Remote Subject Matter Expert


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting 3D Artists and VFX experts with experience creating computer generated scenes and assets to join our global network for a high level gaming project.


Rather than traditional VFX work, we are offering an opportunity to licence existing ‘on-the-shelf’ works from your archives, plus hourly compensation for technical processing.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Asset licencing: Licence existing works from your personal/ studio archives for a flat fee
  • Technical processing including rendering, layering, and preparing these files to our data specifications
  • In some cases, making variations to scenes and re-rendering


Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching


What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a 3D, Technical or VFX Artist or Compositor in games, film or digital production
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity & Houdini, Maya / Blender / Cinema4D and similar
  • Expertise in rendering, lighting and texturing
  • Comfortable using technical workflows and tools
  • Existing assets for licensing, with scenes separated into coherent, compositable layers


Nice To Have

  • Experience in the Gaming industry
  • Elements including depth, albedo, shading, gloss, cryptomat
  • Complex occlusions, atmospherics and crowd dynamics


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.



Why join this project?

This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join a North American team supporting a hybrid environment with a strong focus on VMware and Azure Cloud. This role is primarily hands-on and involves managing, modernizing, and migrating a large-scale virtualized environment to the cloud, while also supporting core networking and security components. The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

title: Dispatcher
description:
Our client is a growing nationwide network of home service experts on a mission to bring world-class service to every American household with the utmost convenience. The company is committed to providing convenient, comprehensive, and ‌professional home services to families nationwide. They are guided by values of customer obsession, an execution-first approach, and an \"invent and simplify\" mentality.


We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Dispatcher/HR to coordinate and oversee daily cleaning and service schedules by assigning cleaners, confirming client readiness, and ensuring quality service delivery. The Dispatcher acts as the link between customers, cleaners, and management, ensuring smooth daily operations, proper documentation, and customer satisfaction. 


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Prior experience in dispatch, scheduling, or logistics.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication with both customers and field staff.
  • Ability to manage stress and resolve scheduling conflicts in real time.
  • Proficiency in BookingKoala CRM, OpenPhone, RingCentral, and Google Workspace.
  • Attention to detail with clock-in/out monitoring, photo uploads, and reports.
  • Ability to hire, train, and oversee service providers.
  • English fluency; Spanish preferred (Los Angeles/Miami markets).
  • Flexibility to cover evenings and weekends as required.


DUTIES


Scheduling & Daily Dispatch


  • Assign daily jobs to cleaners in BookingKoala.
  • Monitor same-day jobs to ensure start times are met.
  • Confirm cleaner clock-in/clock-out and require before/after photos.
  • For Airbnb clients: collect damage reports, supply alerts, and before/after pictures.
  • Verify next-day schedules with both clients and cleaners.
  • Maintain updated cleaner calendars (minimum two weeks ahead).


Customer & Cleaner Support


  • Answer incoming calls and resolve service-related questions.
  • Provide cleaners with clear instructions (special notes, supplies, reporting requirements).
  • Handle reschedules and urgent client requests.
  • Conduct Happy Calls after cleanings to confirm satisfaction.


Sales & Overflow Coverage


  • Take incoming sales calls when CSR is unavailable.
  • Send quotes and update CRM as needed.
  • Support upselling and follow-ups when covering evening/weekend shifts.


Hiring & Onboarding


  • Conduct weekly recruiting campaigns (e.g., Care.com and other sources).
  • Call at least 15 leads per week and conduct 6+ interviews.
  • Onboard 3–5 qualified cleaners weekly across Los Angeles (Pacific Time) and Miami (Eastern Time).
  • Send onboarding emails and guides, set up training schedules.
  • Collect W-9 forms and proof of insurance from all regular providers.
  • Develop and update provider SOPs and training materials.


Quality & Performance Management


  • Review provider performance, verify documentation, and ensure SOP compliance.
  • Identify top performers and support bonus/recognition processes.
  • Escalate and resolve quality issues promptly.


Reporting & Communication


  • Update daily scorecards for Los Angeles and Miami.
  • Provide Slack updates summarizing daily dispatch results.
  • Attend HSA Sales/Training calls.
  • Document missed calls and unresponsive customers in shared sheets.


Systems & Process Management


  • Maintain a dedicated phone line for cleaner communication (separate from client and lead lines).
  • Continuously improve onboarding, communication, and SOP processes.

title: Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations
description:
Company Description

RxDiet is a healthcare technology company that provides medically tailored groceries and clinical behavioral health interventions for patients. Our proprietary artificial intelligence and national grocery retail integrations allow us to deliver these solutions to patients, meeting them where they are. Our mission is to empower members' healthcare journeys by unlocking the full potential of food as medicine.


Role Description

We are looking for a Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations to take ownership of our integrations with third-party retailers in the United States. You will work closely with the engineering and devops team. This is a do-it-all role, and we need an individual who wants to get their hands dirty. This role is full-time remote.


What we are looking for:

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience, with Kotlin as the primary language; strong Java experience is considered if paired with a genuine interest in adopting Kotlin.
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot and production-grade application development.
  • Strong command of authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, token lifecycle management) across a range of integration architectures.
  • Proficiency working with both REST and GraphQL APIs, including handling underdocumented or evolving third-party interfaces.
  • Experience designing and working within microservices architectures, including asynchronous communication via Apache ActiveMQ.
  • Hands-on experience with frontend reverse engineering and web scraping, including browser automation tools such as Puppeteer or Playwright.
  • Experience integrating with grocery or food retailer APIs (order management, product catalogs, availability, or fulfillment) is a strong competitive advantage.
  • General AWS knowledge including S3, and familiarity with core AWS services and best practices.
  • General frontend knowledge and familiarity with modern frameworks (React, Vue, or similar).
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
  • Ready to respond to outages and troubleshoot issues quickly when things break.
  • It's a bonus if you're interested in food-as-medicine, startups, or community health.


Our Perks


  • Competitive salary structure.
  • Full flexibility for remote work (Work from anywhere).
  • One annual company-wide offsite event.
  • Unlimited time off policy.
  • Be an integral part of a supportive, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.


RxDiet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and strives to create a diverse and inclusive environment. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and are committed to non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Experiência prática com Airflow (DAGs, Operators, Sensors).

  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL. Experiência com Snowflake (ambiente analítico). Domínio de SQL. Vivência com controle de versão (Git).

  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura.
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited to hear from you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or passionate about our mission to create a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.


What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce , the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods.


Bonus Points

Experience with Kafka for event-streaming

Experience extracting microservices from a monolith


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: AR / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter


Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: AR / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter


Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Career Products Technical Specialist
description:
Carreira USA has built its reputation on delivering high-quality services supported by a team of dedicated professionals. This client-focused approach has fostered strong relationships, earning customer trust and driving consistent repeat business.

We are seeking a personable, people-oriented professional with strong passion and a deep understanding of the U.S. job market to serve as a Career Consultant. This individual should genuinely celebrate others’ successes, bringing a supportive and encouraging approach while leading interview training and delivering strategic career guidance for clients.

This role involves individualized career support and guiding candidates through U.S. hiring standards and expectations. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with corporate hiring processes in the U.S., along with excellent analytical and communication skills.

Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software ;

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD



Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production.  The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions.  Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack.  Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy.  CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders.  Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set.  Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop.  User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents.  Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer:  TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration:  Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer:  Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure:  Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
Financial Reporting Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst tto support financial reporting, analysis, and data-driven decision-making, ensuring accuracy, visibility, and actionable insights across the business.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Reporting Analyst / Accountant to support financial reporting, accounting operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This role bridges financial reporting and accounting, ensuring accurate financial records, reliable reporting, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with analytical capabilities, contributing to both operational excellence and strategic visibility.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
  • Maintain accuracy and integrity of financial data across reports and systems
  • Support general accounting activities, including reconciliations and journal entries
  • Ensure proper classification and recording of financial transactions
  • Assist in month-end and year-end close processes
  • Identify trends, variances, and key drivers of financial performance
  • Deliver insights to support business and financial decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and validate financial data
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with accounting standards and policies
  • Improve financial reporting processes, tools, and documentation
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and support finance-related initiatives


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles
  • Experience with month-end close and reconciliations
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with large datasets and translate data into insights
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally


Nice to Have

  • CPA or equivalent certification (or in progress)
  • Experience with financial reporting tools or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Familiarity with financial controls and compliance processes
  • Experience in high-growth or scaling environments
  • Background in process improvement and automation


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Accounting Operations Assistant (Construction & Property Services)


Location: Remote (LATAM)

Schedule: 40 hours/week (Monday–Friday; occasional Saturdays may be required)

Salary: $2,000–$3,000 USD/month


About Our Client


Our client is a Houston-based construction and property maintenance company with over a decade of experience delivering turnkey solutions across the United States. They specialize in ground-up construction, renovations, property maintenance, and customized facility solutions for a diverse client base that includes national brands, REITs, and educational institutions.


Position Overview


They are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Accounting Operations Assistant with strong experience in QuickBooks Online to support our day-to-day operations. This role is critical to ensuring smooth financial and administrative processes across multiple ongoing projects.


The ideal candidate has experience working with U.S.-based companies—preferably in construction or property services—and is comfortable managing a wide range of accounting and administration-related responsibilities remotely.


Key Responsibilities


Accounting & Financial Support (QuickBooks Online)

  • Manage all QuickBooks Online activities, including:
  • Invoicing and billing
  • Accounts payable and receivable
  • Expense tracking and categorization
  • Bank and credit card reconciliations
  • Generate financial reports and assist with budgeting and cost tracking
  • Support payroll processing and contractor payments (as needed)

Project & Operations Support

  • Assist with project tracking, timelines, and documentation
  • Support compliance-related documentation (e.g., contracts, insurance, permits)
  • Help coordinate maintenance schedules and service requests
  • Ensure accurate record-keeping across multiple active projects

Administrative Support

  • Manage daily administrative operations, ensuring efficiency across departments
  • Coordinate schedules, meetings, and internal communications
  • Maintain organized digital filing systems and project documentation
  • Assist with vendor communication and subcontractor coordination


Qualifications


  • Proven experience as a Bookkeeper, Administrative Assistant, or similar role
  • Extensive hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (required)
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies (construction industry experience is a strong plus)
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in construction, property management, or facility services
  • Familiarity with project management tools or CRMs
  • Knowledge of U.S. compliance and documentation processes (e.g., W-9s, COIs, permits)


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Long-term, stable remote opportunity
  • Exposure to large-scale, multi-sector construction projects across the U.S.
  • A collaborative and fast-growing team environment

title: Analista de Implantação ERP – Módulo Fiscal/Contábil
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).



Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;

  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to lead electrical design and calculations for complex architectural and MEP projects. This is a high-impact role focused on ensuring compliance with Florida Building Codes , energy performance standards, and accurate engineering documentation across multiple disciplines. This is a remote position, supporting US-based projects in the EST timezone .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform electrical engineering calculations , including load analysis, circuit design, lighting, and energy performance compliance.
  • Review and validate MEP calculations from internal teams and external consultants.
  • Collaborate with architectural, mechanical, and plumbing teams to coordinate multi-discipline designs.
  • Ensure Life Safety, Means of Egress, and ADA compliance for electrical systems.
  • Contribute to permit-ready Construction Document (CD) sets and ensure adherence to Miami / Florida Building Codes.
  • Review technical specifications, quantity takeoffs, and CSI documentation for accuracy.
  • Estimate project hours and prepare detailed scopes of work .
  • Support energy modeling, performance compliance, and sustainability documentation.


Required Experience:

  • 2+ years in Electrical Engineering within construction, or MEP environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Miami / Florida Building Codes .
  • Experience coordinating across architectural and MEP disciplines .
  • US-based project experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in BIM, Revit, AutoCAD , and construction documentation workflows.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting US permitting workflows .
  • Experience with remote engineering production environments .


Work Setup:

  • Fully remote
  • EST timezone availability required

title: Analista de Implantação ERP – Módulo Fiscal/Contábil
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).



Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
  • Experiência com Varejo;
  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
  • Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Sobre nós:

A Xcelis é composta por um time de especialistas em Supply Chain, temos mais de 15 anos otimizando e transformando resultados de empresas do Brasil e exterior.

Atuamos de ponta a ponta na cadeia, indo do desenho à implantação com projetos de otimização de performance e resultados em Supply Chain olhando para Malha Logística, Transportes, Warehouse, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Tecnologia e Torre de Controle.

Somos certificados em Clima Organizacional pela FEEx 2023, 2024 e 2025, eleitos como líderes como Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services e Contender no quadrante Supply Chain IT Operation Services do estudo ISG Provider Lens™ Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 e também premiados em 2023, como 1º lugar pelo INBRASC como Consultoria Logística e Fornecedor de TMS!


Buscamos um profissional Sênior com forte experiência em logística e profundo conhecimento em configuração, implantação e sustentação de WMS Manhattan para atuar na implementação e evolução das soluções WMS. Este especialista será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções sistêmicas eficientes, orientar equipes técnicas e garantir a excelência na entrega.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos de implantação de sistemas WMS e TMS, assegurando alinhamento entre negócio, TI e fornecedores.
  • Conduzir a gestão dos projetos com foco em: Qualidade da solução entregue; Gestão de escopo; Controle de custos; Cumprimento de prazos; Identificação e mitigação de riscos; Integração e coesão do time multidisciplinar.
  • Garantir comunicação clara e contínua com stakeholders, proporcionando visibilidade das ações, status, riscos e decisões críticas.
  • Gerenciar equipes de TI envolvidas nos projetos, promovendo alinhamento, priorização e eficiência na execução das entregas.
  • Participar e facilitar sessões de levantamento de requisitos, mapeamento de processos e definição de soluções.
  • Monitorar a qualidade das entregas do time, assegurando aderência às necessidades do negócio e aos padrões técnicos definidos.
  • Atuar como facilitador na integração entre áreas operacionais, clientes, fornecedores e times internos.
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados artefatos de gestão, como cronogramas, planos de comunicação, planos de teste e relatórios executivos.
  • Avaliar impactos de mudanças e garantir governança de escopo durante todo o projeto.
  • Assegurar que todas as implementações sigam as diretrizes de segurança da informação e padrões do portfólio tecnológico da DHL.
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua das práticas de gestão de projetos dentro da área.



Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de tecnologia , preferencialmente envolvendo implantação ou evolução de sistemas (WMS, TMS, ERP, automações ou integrações).
  • Diferencial: vivência no setor de Logística e Supply Chain , especialmente em operações de transporte, armazenagem ou distribuição.
  • Experiência com metodologias de gestão de projetos no modelo PMP , incluindo governança, controle de mudanças, riscos e comunicação.
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em abordagens ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e capacidade de atuar em ambientes híbridos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, facilitação e negociação com múltiplos perfis de stakeholders.
  • Perfil proativo, com senso de urgência , foco em resultado e habilidade de tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa, influenciar equipes e navegar em ambientes complexos.

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

IM Digital is a forward-thinking commerce consultancy dedicated to helping world-class brands build their digital foundation, optimize operations, and drive revenue growth. Through innovative strategies, the company creates value with speed and scale, ensuring clients are equipped to navigate an ever-evolving digital landscape. As a trusted partner, IM Digital provides expert guidance and solutions to accelerate success.


About the Role

We are looking for a Email Graphic Designer to lead and elevate creative execution across our Retention & Lifecycle Marketing team. This role is ideal for a highly skilled designer who not only produces exceptional email creative but also drives efficiency through design systems, mentors junior talent, and contributes to broader marketing storytelling through high-impact visual content.


You will play a key role in shaping how brands communicate with their customers across email and lifecycle channels—while also extending creative into thought leadership assets such as case studies, one-pagers, and slide decks used across LinkedIn and other marketing channels.


As part of our Creative Guild , you’ll collaborate with cross-functional creative leaders across UI/UX, branding, and digital experience to continuously evolve our standards and capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and execution of high-performing email campaigns and automated lifecycle programs across multiple clients
  • Translate marketing strategy into compelling, conversion-focused creative that aligns with brand guidelines
  • Develop polished one-pagers, case studies, and presentation decks for use in marketing, sales, and thought leadership (e.g., LinkedIn, blog content)
  • Own and evolve email design systems , including reusable components, templates, and documentation to improve speed and consistency
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, campaign managers, developers, and other creatives to deliver best-in-class lifecycle experiences
  • Oversee the preparation and handoff of designs in Figma for seamless implementation across platforms
  • Incorporate and optimize AI-driven workflows (e.g., generative imagery, copy, and layout exploration)
  • Configure and refine AI agents to generate content aligned with brand voice and creative standards
  • Analyze creative performance and iterate based on insights to continuously improve results
  • Manage multiple projects and timelines across a portfolio of clients

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor and provide guidance to Junior Email Graphic Designers , supporting skill development and creative quality
  • Conduct design reviews and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Help establish and uphold creative best practices across the team
  • Contribute to onboarding and training materials for new creative team members

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in email design, digital design, or lifecycle marketing creative
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and strong command of design systems and component-based design
  • Proven ability to create visually compelling marketing assets beyond email (e.g., decks, case studies, one-pagers)
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, hierarchy, and conversion-focused design principles
  • Experience working in fast-paced, client-facing or agency environments
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and time management skills
  • Ability to balance creative vision with performance-driven outcomes

title: Revley Payments Engineer — Stripe Connect / White-Label Payments Platform
description:
Company Description

Revley is the commerce operating system for the next generation of subscription brands. Headquartered in Manhattan. Bootstrapped. Profitable.


We exist because the modern commerce stack is broken. Brands stitch together a checkout from one vendor, a subscription engine from another, a payment processor from a third, a chargeback tool from a fourth — and spend more time managing the seams than growing. We replace all of it. One platform. Payments, subscriptions, checkout, tokenization, analytics, and revenue protection — unified, owned by the merchant, portable across every processor.


Our largest merchant processes $20M/month. In 8 months we've signed enterprise contracts with 12 partners including Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Nuvei, NMI, Finix, Braintree, and Authorize.net. Brands using Revley don't rent their payment infrastructure. They own it.


We move fast, ship daily, and treat every merchant relationship like the one that defines the company. We value ownership, transparency, and craftsmanship over process. We build for ambitious teams the way we'd want to be built for. If you've ever looked at the commerce stack and thought this should be one thing, not ten — you already understand Revley.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Payments Engineer specializing in Stripe Connect and white-label payments platforms at Revley. The role includes designing, building, and optimizing scalable payment infrastructure, integrating Stripe Connect, and enabling white-label payment solutions. This engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure and seamless payment processing, proactively identify and address technical challenges, and stay updated with emerging payment technologies.


Qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe Connect, white-label payment solutions, and payment system design
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Ruby for payment platform development
  • Hands-on experience with API integrations and handling webhooks
  • Understanding of PCI compliance, data security, and regulations related to payment processing
  • Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to address technical challenges in payment operations
  • Collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with product and design teams
  • Previous experience with subscription or SaaS-based business models is a plus
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent field is preferred
