title: Senior Front End Developers
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and a global leader in innovative IT solutions, with offices in 

London, UK, and a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes 

in transformative, future-ready solutions, including Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and 

enterprise application optimization, with a strong focus on Oracle Cloud and database technologies. 

Backed by over 45+ technology experts and led by visionary leadership, MillionLogics delivers 

tailored and results-driven technology solutions. Committed to empowering organizations 

worldwide, the company embraces innovation and excellence to drive digital transformation. To learn 

more, visit: millionlogics.com . 


Role Overview :

We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer with strong expertise in React and Next.js to build scalable, high-quality user interfaces for RL environment platforms. The role involves owning UI development, contributing to backend integrations when needed, and ensuring performance, usability, and maintainability. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and help drive frontend architecture decisions.


Offer Details  : 

•Contract Duration  : 12 months 

•Pay  : US$ 1500 (take-home) per task 

•Experience :  5+ years  

•Positions  : 20  

•Work Mode   : Fully Remote


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Build scalable, reusable, high-performance frontend applications using React
  • Collaborate with product, design, backend, and QA teams
  • Develop and maintain UI components and design systems
  • Integrate with Python (Fast API) backend services
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and responsiveness
  • Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews
  • Troubleshoot UI issues and ensure cross-browser compatibility
  • Ensure code quality through testing and best practices
  • Mentor junior developers and support team growth


Requirements :

  • 5+ years of frontend development experience
  • Strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Experience with REST APIs and backend integration
  • Good understanding of Python and backend concepts (Fast API preferred)
  • Experience building scalable applications and reusable UI architectures
  • Familiarity with Git, build tools (Web pack/Viet), and testing frameworks (Jest, Cypress, Playwright)
  • Understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and Agile workflows


Nice to have skills :

  • Experience with micro frontend architecture and design systems
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and DevOps (Docker, CI/CD)
  • Exposure to authentication/authorization systems
  • Experience with performance monitoring or data-driven applications
  • Strong communication, ownership, and collaboration skills

﻿

How to Apply :

Please send us your CV to with job ID-72808 as your email subject.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Revley Payments Engineer — Stripe Connect / White-Label Payments Platform
description:
Company Description

Revley is the commerce operating system for the next generation of subscription brands. Headquartered in Manhattan. Bootstrapped. Profitable.


We exist because the modern commerce stack is broken. Brands stitch together a checkout from one vendor, a subscription engine from another, a payment processor from a third, a chargeback tool from a fourth — and spend more time managing the seams than growing. We replace all of it. One platform. Payments, subscriptions, checkout, tokenization, analytics, and revenue protection — unified, owned by the merchant, portable across every processor.


Our largest merchant processes $20M/month. In 8 months we've signed enterprise contracts with 12 partners including Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Nuvei, NMI, Finix, Braintree, and Authorize.net. Brands using Revley don't rent their payment infrastructure. They own it.


We move fast, ship daily, and treat every merchant relationship like the one that defines the company. We value ownership, transparency, and craftsmanship over process. We build for ambitious teams the way we'd want to be built for. If you've ever looked at the commerce stack and thought this should be one thing, not ten — you already understand Revley.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Payments Engineer specializing in Stripe Connect and white-label payments platforms at Revley. The role includes designing, building, and optimizing scalable payment infrastructure, integrating Stripe Connect, and enabling white-label payment solutions. This engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure and seamless payment processing, proactively identify and address technical challenges, and stay updated with emerging payment technologies.


Qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe Connect, white-label payment solutions, and payment system design
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Ruby for payment platform development
  • Hands-on experience with API integrations and handling webhooks
  • Understanding of PCI compliance, data security, and regulations related to payment processing
  • Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to address technical challenges in payment operations
  • Collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with product and design teams
  • Previous experience with subscription or SaaS-based business models is a plus
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent field is preferred

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

Employment Type: Contract

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Back-End / Platform Engineer to design and build scalable, data-driven APIs and backend services. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in GraphQL, Node.js, and TypeScript , along with experience in cloud-native and containerized environments.


Mandatory Skills

  • GraphQL
  • API Development (GraphQL & REST)

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize backend services interacting with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Design and manage GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and performance optimization

  • Implement API security, versioning, and governance best practices
  • Deploy and manage services using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Work with cloud platforms (AWS or OCI) to build scalable and reliable systems
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with API development (GraphQL & REST)
  • Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure - OCI)
  • Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Node.js (preferred), Java (Spring Boot), or Python
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

title: 1st Level Tech Support Agent
description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. At Kyniska, we are committed to enabling professional growth and creating impactful employment connections.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional. Responsibilities include delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing customer experience through proficient problem-solving and communication. The individual will handle customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat, troubleshoot technical issues, and work diligently to resolve customer concerns while maintaining professional and empathetic interaction.

Qualifications
  • Strong skills in Customer Service and Customer Support, ensuring the ability to manage and resolve client inquiries efficiently.
  • Expertise in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience, with a focus on delivering solutions to improve customer relationships.
  • Proficiency in Phone Etiquette and effective communication skills, providing a professional and empathetic approach to customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while being a collaborative team player.
  • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.
